title: China-Inspired Adapted Opportunities
description: Real, currently-operating Indian/Telugu-state adaptations of Chinese business models named in the package brief (social commerce, livestream selling, rental businesses, WhatsApp automation, agri-commerce, homestays), verified rather than assumed to exist.
scope_note: Facebook Marketplace (named in the brief) was checked and confirmed NOT officially launched in India; documented explicitly rather than silently substituted.

provenance.collection_method: WebSearch-based knowledge engineering research across two passes: RC1 (category-classification depth) followed by a v2 deep-enrichment pass (2026-07-24) that expanded every row to the 36-column Business Opportunity schema. Direct WebFetch to .gov.in/.ac.in/.nic.in domains was blocked by this session's organizational egress policy (confirmed HTTP 403, live-tested immediately before collection began) for both passes. Every fact is a cited search result; none fabricated. Numeric investment figures required a specific citable government project-profile document or were left as the bare PENDING_VERIFICATION sentinel.
provenance.confidence_calibration_note: Government-project-profile-grade sources scored 70-85; portal/blog-only estimates capped at 58-65; no row exceeds 85 since no direct fetch was possible this session.

license: Compiled from public government, industry-association, and reputable business-journalism sources for ValueWeave internal knowledge-graph use; per-row source attribution preserved in source_url.
